messages:
Sam (Sales): Customer asks for hosted keys for POC. Wants: staging demo key (48h), CI runner key (14d with auto-rotate), and CIDR allowlist. Also flagged in security questionnaire: keys must be revocable and stored only in KMS-backed vaults. Can we do this?
Priya (Solutions): Yes. Proposed: 1) staging_demo: ttl=48h, scopes=generate,streaming; delivery via secure DM + add to SQA tracker. 2) ci_runner: ttl=14d, automated rotation every 7d via rotation webhook; store new secret in their Vault path. Any special HSM/KMS requirements?
Sam (Sales): Customer requests HSM-backed KMS and a documented rotation webhook URL for their CI. Also they want a deprovision checklist at POC end.
Jin (Infra): We support KMS-backed secrets. For HSM keys we need an enterprise add-on (confirm with AM). Rotation webhook pattern we use: POST /internal/hooks/keys/rotate with payload {key_id, callback_url}. Example: 
ops-bot: ```
# create staging demo key
/create-hosted-key --name staging_demo --ttl 172800 --scopes generate,streaming --allowlist 198.51.100.0/24
Result: key_id=hk_stg_5a1
Secret delivered via secure DM
```
Jin (Infra): For CI runner, we'll create hk_ci_21c and register webhook. Our runner will push rotated secrets to their Vault path: secret/data/acme/poc/ci. Use short-lived rotation tokens.
Rosa (Security): Notes from questionnaire: 1) All POC-hosted keys must be listed in the SQA tracker with owner and TTL. 2) Delivery methods allowed: secure DM OR customer-managed Vault path with RBAC. 3) Retain audit logs for 90 days (customer required). 4) Revoke on POC end and record in ticketing system. 5) If HSM requested, attach signed addendum.
Priya (Solutions): I'll add the deprovision checklist to the SOW: revoke keys, confirm vault purge, close ticket, and generate audit export.
Sam (Sales): Can ops confirm webhook format and token rotation procedure so I can pass to customer?
Jin (Infra): Webhook flow: we call customer callback with a signed JWT (kid=rotator-1). Customer must prove TLS and verify signature. Example rotate request we send: 
ops-bot: ```json
{
  "key_id": "hk_ci_21c",
  "new_secret_path": "secret/data/acme/poc/ci",
  "issued_at": 1679000000
}
```
Jin (Infra): The admin token used by the rotator is ephemeral and stored in our Vault. Runner has least-privilege role: keys.rotate and logs.write.
Rosa (Security): Also require a monthly review if POC extends beyond 30 days. For this customer, 14d CI key is ok. If they extend past 30d, switch to Dedicated or increase controls.
Priya (Solutions): Action items: 1) Jin create keys + register webhook (ETA today). 2) Rosa add SQA entries and confirm audit retention. 3) Sam share HSM/AM contact if customer pushes HSM add-on.
ops-bot: hk_stg_5a1 created and delivered. hk_ci_21c created; webhook registered; rotation schedule set to every 7 days.
Sam (Sales): Thanks — I'll update the sales playbook and send the deprovision checklist to the customer.
Priya (Solutions): I'll post proof of delivery and close out once customer confirms vault receipt. :white_check_mark:
